name: Azure Ryujin

rawReview.finding: All raw source and battle clips visually inspected. No body/head disconnection or mesh distortion outside the repaired death take. The v3 fall settles on its flank; tail and whiskers remain coherent, with no unnatural support point visible.

runtimeReview.hostTransforms: During all death substeps, root/body position and rotation remain zero except root vertical landing correction (maximum 0.01848 world units). Authored v3 metadata guard is true for every death substep in source and battle; no generic second collapse is applied.

reviveSameTimelineComparison.finding: The residual approximately -0.0051 world-unit minimum is equivalent to the exact public-model baseline (difference under 0.00004), at the same revive timeline and vertex location. This is existing floor normalization, not a v3-introduced defect. Earlier public death/revive penetration reached approximately -0.23 world units; v3 death is at numerical zero.

runtimeReview.visualFinding: Low and medium source/battle head and body sheets personally inspected. The new death falls smoothly onto the flank with continuous head/body silhouette; the revive lifts without the prior deep floor collapse. No visible face, whisker, tail, or limb distortion.

scopeNote: The candidate changed only death root translation/rotation; companion idle and technique curves are unchanged and were not recaptured. This is a private-candidate review only, not a production promotion or release certification.

preservedFailingControl.status: Numeric negative control recorded before final exact-floor correction. The old runtime manifests and sheets were overwritten by the final current-hash reruns; this report preserves the observed minimum values, not the old pixel files.
